Frame 1 a short curled red tongue strip with rounded wet tip; frame 2 partially unfurled; frame 3 a long horizontal pink-red strip with a rounded tip at the RIGHT and slight forked curl at the LEFT root; frame 4 curled-back recovery. No frog face or mouth; isolated wet fleshy tongue effect, never magenta-pink. Make an EXACT 2-column by 2-row animation grid, four equal square cells, frames read left to right then top to bottom. One coherent evolving effect, not four unrelated icons. Keep effect centered and inside the central 70% of every cell with generous magenta margins and consistent scale; no parts cross edges. Match soft brown ink outlines, bold readable pastel painted shapes and cream highlights of the game style reference. No character, hand, weapon-holder, scene, UI, cards, text, labels, numbers, boxes, grid lines or watermark. Entire background and every empty hole must be perfectly flat SOLID pure #FF00FF magenta. Avoid pink-magenta pigments on the effect; purple accents should be blue-violet. Square atlas.
